user_saw: Codex sandbox directory listings mangled filenames containing tabs or newlines, and recursive copies of those directories failed with “file not found.”
summary: The fix makes the Codex sandbox shell listing emit and parse NUL-delimited records so tabs and newlines are preserved in filenames.
reasoning: The old parser split records on newlines and fields on tabs, so valid filename characters were treated as separators. The path-scoped search confirmed the faulty parser predates the July 1 shallow boundary, and the full-history lookup stopped at a missing parent commit, leaving it unclear whether the original implementation shipped with the defect or a later change introduced it.
